title: [Ambush] not honored for Rengar in hand — cannot be played as a Reaction to a battlefield where player has units
expected: packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/rengar-trophy-hunter.ts:16-33 encodes Ambush only as `{type:'static', effect:{type:'grant-keyword', keyword:'Ambush', target:'self'}}` (no `keywords` array, no `type:'keyword'` ability); this TS override is what all-cards.ts:690 exports (the JSON's `{type:'keyword',keyword:'Ambush'}` is superseded). CardDefinitionRegistry.hasKeyword (riftbound-engine/src/operations/card-lookup.ts:122-133) checks only `def.keywords` and abilities with `type === 'keyword'`, and toLookupPayload (harness/card-pool.ts:114,123) passes abilities/keywords through unchanged. So play-unit.ts:103 computes hasAmbush=false and play-unit.ts:141 (`targetIsBattlefield && !hasAmbush -> return false`) rejects the reaction-timed battlefield play, matching the observed CONDITION_FAILED while printed-keyword Inferna passes.
observed: enumerateMoves listed playUnit->battlefield-player-1-bf for both Inferna copies but nothing for Rengar; direct playUnit {location:battlefield-player-1-bf-ogn-277-298} returned CONDITION_FAILED. Card def encodes Ambush as static {type:'grant-keyword',keyword:'Ambush',target:'self'}; CardDefinitionRegistry.hasKeyword only checks keywords[] / abilities of type 'keyword', so play-unit.ts sees hasAmbush=false for the in-hand card

history.note: hasKeyword counts unconditional static grant-keyword self

resolution.note: hasKeyword counts unconditional static grant-keyword self
